name: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir
role: Secretary General of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party
contribution: He served as BNP's senior strategist and public spokesman through the 2026 election campaign and the party's return to parliament.
context: BNP campaign leadership and parliamentary party formation in 2026.
impact: He helped translate BNP's electoral victory into a governing and parliamentary agenda.
highlight: The BNP's top organizational voice during the 2026 campaign.
